source.citation: Dinerstein E. et al. (2017) An Ecoregion-Based Approach to Protecting Half the Terrestrial Realm. BioScience 67(6):534-545. doi:10.1093/biosci/bix014
source.note: Boundaries simplified for display (Douglas-Peucker, topology preserving) and small polygon parts dropped; areas are computed from the unsimplified shapes. Nature Needs Half (NNH) categories are RESOLVE's 2017 assessment of how much of each ecoregion is protected or intact. SEED (subsampled to stay under 100 KB): the 14 biomes dissolved from their ecoregions, simplified at 0.75 deg, snapped to a 0.01 deg grid, parts and holes under 2.0 square degrees dropped (removes small islands and every Antarctic ecoregion); run pipeline/run_ecoregions.sh for the 846 ecoregions.
